events.title: How Long Will War Angels Be?
events.summary: Here's is quick picture of how long War Angels will be. For the main story itself there will be 50+ events and most of them require your decisions. Throughout the story, you will follow Ahmed and the volunteer doctors trying to keep their hospital alive as the situation outside continues to deteriorate. Bombings spread, supplies become harder to find, patients keep arriving, and every decision becomes more difficult when you simply cannot save everyone.But the main story is only part of the game

events.title: War Angels – Public Playtest Post-Mortem (March 10 – April 10)
events.summary: Hi everyone,Over the past month, we ran a public playtest for War Angels, and we want to share what we learned.This wasn’t just about testing systems, it was about understanding how players feel when they’re forced to make difficult decisions under pressure. events.title: Hello & Publishing Update
events.summary: Hey everyone,Welcome to the very first devlog for War Angels. We’re really happy to finally start sharing updates with you here.We want to kick things off with some big news: we’re officially working with RockGame as our publisher, which means War Angels will be published by RockGame.As development went on, we realized that making War Angels the way we want to make it also means getting the right support.
